# pipeline-crm (deliberately broken demo)

A tiny CRM in the shape AI app builders generate: Vite + React single-page app, Supabase
migrations, Supabase Edge Functions (Deno) for Stripe. It was written by hand for the
prelaunch-audit-report tests and has **security holes on purpose**. The ground truth is in
`../pipeline-crm-app.holes.json`. Never deploy it.
